data.name: HOPE FALLS
data.detailed_description:
The world is about to end. A massive asteroid is on its way, and everyone knows it. In Hope Falls, you play as John, a man caught between survival, memory, and the choices that shape his last days.

Explore the town, meet factions fighting for their own future, and uncover what remains worth living for when time is running out. Your decisions decide who stands with you and who becomes your enemy.

First person action, exploration, and story come together in a game about hope, loss, and survival against the chaos of the end.

FEATURES

  • A survival game you cannot win - The asteroid is coming no matter what. The real test is how you spend your final days.

  • Loot, trade, and survive - Scavenge supplies, sell what you don’t need, and buy items to stay one step ahead of the end.

  • Craft and cook to survive - Scavenge materials, craft useful items, and cook meals to stay alive as the world falls apart.

  • Procedural house exploration - Every house is unique. Loot, furniture, and secrets are randomized, making exploration fresh each run.

  • Faction system - Four factions fight for control: Sixers, Outlaws, Cultists, and Cannibals. Earn their trust or make enemies, your reputation decides how the story plays out.

  • Non Linear Replayability - Different factions, loot, and choices make each playthrough different.

  • Mementos - Collect personal keepsakes tied to people’s memories. Each one carries a story and unlocks unique perks that change gameplay, giving new ways to survive the end.

  • Claim houses as safe spots - Find an abandoned home and make it yours. Store supplies, catch your breath, and hold out against chaos.

  • Dynamic world events - Hope Falls changes as time runs out. Crime rises, panic spreads, and the world reacts to the looming disaster.

  • Story-driven first-person gameplay - A mix of shooting, exploration, and survival wrapped in a narrative about love and loss.

  • Emotional storytelling - A grounded narrative about love, loss, and the human need for hope when all seems lost.

  • Multiple endings through reputation - Walk peacefully into the finale if factions respect you, or fight them all if they don’t.

  • Atmospheric environments - From quiet neighborhoods to forests and the massive Hope Falls waterfall.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD RX 570
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 1080p, 60 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600G / Intel i5-12400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT / NVIDIA RTX 2060
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 2K and ultrawide, 75 FPS
